svg.title: Parental care in amphibians
svg.desc: Four distinct examples of egg carrying, foam nesting, tadpole transport and nutritive egg provisioning.
svg.text: Four species, four examples of how parents protect or nourish offspring

g.text: Fertilised eggs are wound around his hind limbs.
Moist foam surrounds the developing eggs.
He carries them on his back to small pools.
Female feeds them unfertilised nutritive eggs.

svg.text: A and C: adapted CHORDATA illustrations. B and D: schematics. Images are not to scale.
